reviews.text:
DO NOT GO HERE.

My cat suffered a serious degloving injury and this practice made an already traumatic situation even more stressful.

The handling of the insurance claim was awful. I experienced unexpected and unclear charges, additional costs being added, and requests for further payments months after the treatment. The financial side was an absolute mess and left me constantly questioning what I was actually being charged for.

Since leaving this practice, I’ve used two other vets for my cats’ treatment and insurance claims, and the difference has been massive. Everything has been clear, transparent and straightforward. No random charges, no confusion and no chasing months later for additional payments.

After everything we went through with my cat, the last thing I needed was this level of stress over money and insurance.

I would seriously recommend taking your pet elsewhere. Based on my experience, this place felt far more interested in taking money than making an already difficult situation easier for the owner.

They made a scary day feel much more manageable. Directed us first to the pets poison hotline (01202509000,) which was extremely helpful.
Then saw us promptly that very evening. Thank you to all the staff who treated Lausse.
Went in to check for a microchip on a stray cat, the care and attention was way above what I’d expect for a free service. Thank you
Vet was lovely and the staff are very friendly

Losing our beloved cat was one of the hardest things we’ve ever been through, and having to make the decision to say goodbye was absolutely heartbreaking. The team at Vets for Pets were so kind, compassionate and respectful throughout the entire process.

They made an incredibly difficult day as comforting as it could possibly be, and the thoughtful little touches meant so much to us. When we collected her ashes, she had been presented so beautifully, giving us a truly dignified and loving farewell.

Thank you to everyone who cared for our precious girl and for helping us through such a difficult time. We will always be grateful

My dog Dexter choked on his own vomit and had a seizure. As a family we had the worst scare. He stopped breathing and went floppy. I did everything I could to clear his airway and got him to the emergency vets, Donaldsons in Huddersfield. They gave us paracetamol, a £260 bill and sent us away saying his symptoms of breathlessness were normal following a seizure. They failed to recognise his pneumonia.
Vets for pets were the complete opposite. They were so caring and put effort into a diagnosis. After thinking our dog was dying we now have our dog home with the family recovering.
We would like to thank Jonav and the rest of the staff for their help in saving Dexter❤️

£60 parking charge through the door a week after taking a deceased family pet out of hours and using there car park whilst using there services
Absolute vultures .

Unbelievable rip-off! Charging £150 just for a basic temperature check on a critically ill cat, with absolutely zero treatment or medication provided. They don't care about animal welfare, they only care about draining your bank account. Total waste of money and a terrible experience. Disgraceful."

Very disappointing experience. The staff were unhelpful and showed little care or compassion. I took my sick cat to the clinic, but instead of receiving proper help, I was charged £150 just to register my cat. The service was poor, and I felt more focused on paying fees than on my pet’s wellbeing. I would not recommend this vet based on my experience.

We took our sick cat to this veterinary practice expecting compassionate care, but our experience was very disappointing. We were charged £150 just for the initial consultation, which felt very expensive. On top of that, the staff were unfriendly, dismissive, and showed very little empathy while we were worried about our pet.

When your pet is sick, you expect kindness, clear communication, and support. Unfortunately, we left feeling upset and disappointed with both the service and the overall experience. While I understand veterinary care can be expensive, the lack of compassion from the staff made the visit much worse. I wouldn’t recommend this practice based on our experience.

Very disappointed with our experience. Just two days after our cat’s serious degloving injury, we felt pressured into choosing between amputation or surgery costing over £5,000. An independent vet instead advised giving the leg time to heal before making such a major decision.

We were also extremely concerned by the handling of the insurance claim. An overclaim was later confirmed and refunded, but it caused unnecessary stress during an already traumatic time. Poor communication, poor handling of finances, and much higher surgery quotes than an independent practice. We would strongly recommend getting a second opinion.
They’re great with our dog.

Not for the first time, an appointment which should have taken 10 minutes, took an hour. Half an hour after our appointment time before we got to see the nurse, then another half an hour trying, yet again, to get a working blood pressure monitor - in the end, another person had to come in to take it - we still have no idea what our pet's actual blood pressure was!

My dog, Bonnie at only 9 months old started suffering with seizures, we originally was seeing the Vets 4 Pets at brighouse who advised us to try care at home, I then took it upon myself ( 4 hours later ) to take bonnie to the hospital at birstall, she was in the hospital/vets for 8 days .
Almost £7000 later we had bonnie back but not herself and seemed under the influence ( to be expected)
A few hours later the seizures were happing again.
The diagnosis from the hospital/vets was inconclusive.
She was put to sleep at home in comfort 28 hours after leaving the hospital/vets

I took my dog to Vets for Pets as an emergency after she became suddenly lame and in pain.

The vet carried out only a very brief check and quickly pushed for sedation and X-rays without properly examining her leg or paw.

I was charged £973.64, yet no diagnosis was made. The X-rays showed nothing.

After bringing her home, she was still in discomfort. On closer inspection, I found a visible wound with pus at the exact site of pain — something that should have been picked up during a basic physical examination.

Instead, the issue was missed and masked with painkillers, while I was advised to wait two weeks.

Paying nearly £1,000 without a diagnosis, while an obvious problem was overlooked, is completely unacceptable.

I would strongly advise others to question expensive procedures if a proper physical examination has not been carried out first.

UPDATE:

Following my original review of Vets for Pets, I submitted a formal complaint regarding Arya’s treatment.

While this complaint is still ongoing, I have:

- Had my follow-up email ignored
- Been contacted by phone instead of receiving a written response
- Received repeated messages chasing payment and pushing me to complete finance arrangements

This is despite being previously told in writing that my account would be placed on hold until the complaint is investigated and resolved.

Chasing payment — even for a small remaining balance — while an active complaint is unresolved is completely inappropriate.

This, combined with the original issue of paying £973 without a diagnosis while an obvious problem was missed, has significantly undermined my trust in this practice.

I would strongly advise others to ensure thorough examinations are carried out and to be cautious about how complaints are handled.
Thank you for your 5 star review - much appreciated :)

Amazing staff and service. Emergency appointment on a Bank Holiday for our pet cat, Midget. Can't thank them enough, and very reasonably priced. If I could give a sixth star I would... and Midget apologises for scratching the vet. 🐈 …

If I could give them 1 star I could. After being completely negligent a week or so back and leaving our cat without the necessary/basic tests such as bloods - leaving our cat to deteriorate to the point where he needs a blood transfusion, potentially due to FIP (which they would’ve identified if they’d of done basic tests) a disease that can be deadly within weeks if not treated. We’ve taken our cat back due to his deterioration (after our vets stated he needed an emergency blood transfusion), which they’ve refused to do and have stated he needs a repeat of all the tests he’s already had (on the same day, at the same vets but a different location) because they coincidently can’t find the information, which would mean an extensive stay and a repeat of everything that’s already been done and of course a HUGE bill. Our cat is critically anaemic and could go into shock yet they need to repeat tests which could take days all because they can’t find these results. Our whole experience has been shocking at best. We’ve now had to remove him from their care and take him elsewhere.

I’m not sure who I spoke to on the phone on Tuesday night but she was absolutely wonderful, calming me when I was upset my cat had her tail stuck in the door and speaking with kind words.
Once I arrived at the vets, I was seen by a lovely lady (who I did not get the name of) but she was absolutely amazing also, treating both me and my cat with care even though she is an absolute terror when she is at the vets and refuses to let them near her. She walked me through the steps she was taking to try and examine her and what she advised after, both her and the lady I spoke with via the phone are absolutely fabulous and deserve nothing but positive feedback from me !

Amazing caring staff after I lost our cat, so friendly and caring I couldn’t have had a better experience whilst my heart was distraught. I would recommend this vets over and over again. It feels like they shared your emotions and was so empathetic. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart you made the experience so smooth and handled the rest whilst we were heartbroken.

I am extremely disappointed with the service we received from this veterinary practice.
We were told that our cat needed his tail amputated, which caused us a great deal of distress. However, this turned out to be completely unnecessary — his tail healed fully within just two weeks without amputation. Being told such a drastic procedure was required when it clearly was not is deeply concerning.
On top of this, we were charged over £700 initially, plus another £100, and then an additional £100 was added when we collected him, with no clear explanation other than “medication.” This extra charge was not discussed or agreed beforehand, leaving us feeling misled and taken advantage of at an already stressful time.
There was a lack of transparency around both the diagnosis and the costs, and we have lost trust in the advice given by this practice. I would urge other pet owners to ask detailed questions and seek a second opinion before agreeing to major procedures here.

Treated my cat  with patience and understanding while investigating a problem recently massive thank you to Anna who  explained all her blood work results to me thoroughly and we now have a follow up care plan in place for the future thank you once again great work everyone

If I could give less than one star I would. I took my baby (6 year old frenchie) to this vets over 2 days. I was getting mixed answers all of the time even though they could see how quickly my baby girl was deteriorating. At the beginning of the last appointment I was told “I’m happy for you to take her home” I told them that couldn’t happen as my baby could barely breathe after hours of being there my baby crashed and had to go on a ventilator but before my baby crashed they told me that if she happens to crash that they would call me to make full payment before intervening! I had to say to get me a form to fill out to interview so that if needs be they can intervene immediately and they still kept making the payment the forefront of conversation. I have money for my babies no matter what they need but the fact they were happy to let my baby crash and not do anything about it until I lined their pockets is absolutely disgusting!! Putting pets first is a complete and utter LIE. I have used vets4pets for over 7 years now but birstall is appalling and I will NEVER use this vets ever again. The main vet who saw my baby even laughed about my baby needing a tube in her throat when she then told me she could choke if it got blocked which she followed with a giggle. Then told me with boas surgery she would only have 30% chance of making it the when I questioned more as I was desperate to give my baby the best chance she upped it to 70% at this point I knew they were trying to get as much money as they could out of me even when every option they gave me would lead to a life of suffering for my baby girl. Even when I’m sat there heartbroken could barely breath from crying every other word was about payment. I never leave reviews but my baby was treated as an object that they could get money from and my baby is way too special to EVER be disrespected in that way. I hope you’re able to sleep soundly at night knowing that you put money over morals and that pets to you are just a money making scheme no thought or care at all!

We have a dog, Freddie who is very nervous which on occasions can come across as aggression.
Esther, for the last few visits has been extremely kind to Fred, sitting on the floor with him and allowing him to do things in his own time. It has made the world of difference to our visits and I can’t thank her enough. Outstanding care.
Also a shout out to Laura on reception and Amy who have been equally as fantastic in their interactions with Fred.
Great vet care
Friendly staff throughout the building, they all just loved our staff and she loved them even though she is so scared of the vets.

I just used the out of hours service as I was concerned that my dog needed an x-ray. He was seen by Esther who examined him thoroughly & pinpointed the location of his pain. She really put my mind at rest answering all of my questions about how to manage administering his pain meds. If it was nearer I'd register with this practice.

The waiting room is very spacious which is great for reactive dogs.

Finally!, I have found a vets that are just AMAZING! They are kind,understanding & above all very efficient. The vets are so knowledgeable & explain everything as they go along. The staff are just fabulous to deal with. I can’t recommend them enough. X

Elva died under the care of @leedsbirstallvets4pets. What followed was silence, contradiction, and contempt.

She was in systemic collapse. Surgery was delayed for nine hours. I was asked to sign loan forms before any treatment plan was discussed. No urgency. No consent. Just paperwork.

After her death, I reviewed her records. What I found was devastating: 🔹 Sedation undocumented 🔹 Deterioration minimised 🔹 Timelines retro-edited 🔹 A tampon inserted rectally — undocumented, undisclosed, and later referred to in a handwritten note as “tampon up bum”

I was present. I was reachable. I would never have agreed to this.

This isn’t just clinical failure. It’s a collapse of governance, dignity, and truth.

I’ve submitted formal complaints to the RCVS and VCMS. I’m asking for this to be investigated as a standalone safeguarding breach.

#JusticeForElva #VeterinaryAccountability #SafeguardingMatters #RCVS #VCMS #AnimalWelfare #ConsentMatters #DignityInCare #TruthInRecords #EndOfLifeCare #FinancialCoercion #vets4petsbirstallleeds

On the night of 23rd-24th September, my cat suffered a medical emergency. Unfortunately I had to make the tough decision to put her to sleep.
However, despite the trauma and sadness of that night, I do need to acknowledge how helpful and supportive the vet, Sofia, was. She was very nice and understanding, answered all my questions, explained a few things more than once given that my head was in a strange place. She knew exactly when to let me be alone and when to be there for me.
I am very grateful that she helped me navigate that night, and was so respectful and calm.
Thank you for all the support, during and after, to everyone at Birstall, especially Sofia.
Please can loading bays be cleared of rats next and droppings. I've asked multiple times.  I delivery to the building and have to walk through the droppings.  I'm happy to remove when cleared

We’ve been taking our dog to Vets for Pets Birstall for years and sadly can no longer recommend them. Around a year ago, a vet briefly mentioned that our dog might have a heart murmur. When we asked if it was a concern, we were told it was likely just due to age and we should “monitor it and see how she gets on.” Nothing more was explained, and it wasn’t raised again in any meaningful way.

A year later, our dog’s health deteriorated, and after an ultrasound she was diagnosed with heart failure. Just a few days later, we had to make the heartbreaking decision to put her to sleep. None of this, in itself, was their fault – but what happened afterwards was deeply upsetting.

When we went to claim through our pet insurance, the claim was rejected. The insurance company said it was a pre-existing condition, based on medical notes passed over by Vets for Pets. Those notes stated multiple mentions of a heart murmur spanning years – something we were never told about or had explained to us, other than the one brief conversation last year which downplayed it.

Because of this poor communication and lack of transparency, we were left with nearly £900 in vet bills for the scan, believing in good faith that our insurance would cover it. Instead, we were blindsided by details that had never been discussed with us but were recorded on our dog’s file.

This experience has been devastating and has left us feeling completely let down. For that reason, we would strongly advise others to avoid Vets for Pets.

The whole team were wonderful with our poorly beagle Whiskey. We were seen promptly and with great care, even remembered by name which was lovely. Emily the vet was an absolute star with Whiskey and we are so thankful for her and the whole team. He's slowly making a recovery and we will be returning here in future. Easily the most caring vet we have ever been to.

So we bought a dwarf Russian hamster. Got everything there,  cage, wood shavings, food,  toys,  the cage is big and was only £40, way cheaper than the big online stores.
Updated 2.9.25, BTW these cages are unethical,  I've since found out the minimum ethical requirement is 100x50x50cm!! Filled with 8inch deep of bedding and shavings, lots of sprays,sandpits, chewy toys etc etc. By ant times changed since the 80s! Be prepared to spend lots of money for their needs,  as tiny as they are it's an expensive pet x
Came in with Socks a couple of days ago and the vets and staff were lovely. They were incredibly helpful especially for a first time pet owner with a very anxious cat.

The vets here are actually amazing! They all know our little boy by name and genuinely show that they care for each and every animal. After a real scare with his health when he was a puppy, they nurtured him back to health after a 2 week stay in the hospital. Our Chester now adores coming to Birstall to see all the vets and nurses as they always make him feel so welcome and at ease to ensure that he doesn't suffer anxiety for his follow up visits. I cannot recommend them enough here, we wouldn't take Chester anywhere else!

* Update* - The practice manager has since called and rectified this issue and investigated this further so due to this, I'm happy to now leave 3 stars instead of 1 given our complaint was rectified accordingly. Thank you*
We have been a monthly customer of yours for our elderly dog and 5 other pets we own for the past few years now, and we have spent thousands of pounds at your practice...but after the way we were treated today, we will never step foot on your premises ever again!!

The receptionist who works on your evening/night shift is a disgrace to your company.

She refused our dogs treatment who was booked in for an appointment at 8pm, (which we have evidence of) in which we arrived at 7.55pm, and she sent us on our way, stating we shouldn't of never have been booked in for 8pm and that we will have to rearrange the appointment for another time, making me leave with my dog who was in agony with her arthritis with no treatment!!

She tried to belittle us in the middle of your practice, making rude, bold and snarky statements, when she in fact was incorrect and we evidenced this to her, but she still continued to be rude and unhelpful.
Due to her behaviour, we are going through an official complaint at the moment to report this further but you have now lost a very loyal customer with 6 pets who all used your services, we will now be going to Abbey House Vets in future!

Can’t Recommend Enough!

I recently took my dog Max to as he was shaking in pain and drooling. From the very first phone call to booking my appointment, the care and concern were clear. The lovely lady on reception was so kind, and vet Anna was amazing.

They listened, explained everything, and gave me three options, clearly recommending the one they felt was best for Max. It was heartbreaking to leave him, but the receptionist reassured me she would pop in to say hello to him throughout the day, which meant so much.

I dropped him off at 1pm and, after surgery, he was home safe and sound by 9:30pm. They kept me fully updated on the findings and progress, and even did two follow-up calls afterwards to make sure he was recovering well.

The compassion, professionalism, and genuine love for animals shown by the whole team was outstanding. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Max, we are so grateful!

Just want to share a honest review of our experience with vets 4 pets birstall. We’ve had 2 cats signed up to their pet plans for 5+ years & have had minor visits & checkups over the years. Within the last 18 months we feel things have gone downhill & £££ is prioritised. Firstly around 18 months ago we had been called to book a £1000 for dental cleaning by a different department when the vet confirmed it wouldn’t have any impact on a tooth loss that had already occurred and was common. Following on from this when we found a stray cat in need of medical attention unable to eat around 6 weeks ago, we phoned them as our vet to be told “take them on as your own to pay for treatment or call a cat charity”. Another local well known 24hr vet in Morley took the cat in without hesitation, treated and supported a local rehoming charity in looking for a home. Our experience gets more personal from this point. Our cat of 11 years unexpectedly became poorly this past week and started losing weight rapidly. Her treatment was delayed for 2 days due to vet sickness and she was seen on Friday at 7PM. We were told she was chronically poorly but would need diagnosis & treatment if possible or to essentially put her to sleep on the spot, which we felt completely uniformed for to make that decision. I explained we didn’t have insurance & would be willing to fund but that it couldn’t be a blank cheque approach. One quote I remember well asking for blood tests but not being able to upfront agree to all the diagnosis treatment was “are you just looking for a reason to put her to sleep”. We were torn & confused. We were quoted the use of Klarna to pay, a £1500 over night stay, a £500 CT scan. We payed on the spot £330 for an in house blood test and medication to stimulate appetite and took her home with us. Unfortunately overnight and the next day she deteriorated and by 3PM we were back and had decided to put her to sleep. The vet on Saturday night was fantastic and made the situation and her condition clear to us. We opted for communal cremation as opposed to their quoted personal option (another £500) as we weren’t sure what to do with her ashes. We agreed with the vet that her paw prints, nose prints and fur clipping would be returned to us that was written on the form and signed. We were moved to another room and stayed throughout the procedure. What wasn’t fantastic was someone coming in whilst we were still having a moment with our pet, with the card machine to collect the payment for the euthanasia and cremation. We weren’t escaping anywhere and in the past they’ve also sent a payment link. Fast forward to today we called in advance to collect the prints and fur and told they were ready. I’m pleased vets4pets birstall were able to remember to collect payment, as they weren’t able to do the same with our request nor read the form that we signed and were handed a small white envelope with 3 lots of paw prints on plain paper. When I went back in & queried the clippings, I was apologised to and told the instructions hadn’t been fully read, already upset having to collect them, I turned & walked out. I’m really pleased they’ve got their just shy of £500 for blood tests & euthanasia (this didn’t include the appointment cost covered by the pet plan) and want to thank them for making a terrible experience much sadder. A mistake they can’t take back, and we feel it wasn’t a difficult request. We will be cancelling our other cats policy and moving to another vet. The 2 stars is for the vet that dealt with us on the second night, otherwise wouldn’t be recommending them at all.

We had to unfortunately get our cat put to sleep today at Birstall out of hours 😢 I just wanted to give a review to the lovely caring receptionist I didn't get her name but she had blonde hair, from my initial phone call to leaving without our girl she was so kind & caring & even gave me a big hug, credit to your company …

I’m not sure who thought it’s a good idea to have an emergency veterinary care facility located on the first floor of a pet store, on a gallery. Our dog developed a life-threatening condition on a bank holiday and we had to take him there as our usual vet was closed and this is their emergency facility. It was a very unpleasant experience having to walk our poorly boy among the customers. The noise and commotion stressed him out even more.

Our boy was admitted to hospital. Despite assuring us someone would call with an update, nobody did! He was admitted around 4:30pm on Monday and we heard nothing until Tuesday late morning when someone called to say he was doing better and we could take him home. We stayed up until after midnight on Monday and called multiple times only to be told each time someone would call us back. When the vet finally called on Tuesday they advised they had given him chicken despite us making it very clear during the admission he was allergic to it and putting it on a form… When I questioned it I was told there was a mix up with the notes… When I picked him up, they had misplaced his leash (it was found as I requested they looked for it). To be fair they did sort the insurance claim out quickly but forgot to issue us a refund (by own admission, when I called to clarify). We only found out we were due a refund when I called to clarify why the invoice submitted to the insurance company was for a lower amount than what we had paid… As a result we’ll be changing vets because there’s no way I want our boy to have to go there again if he ever needs emergency care.

Last night we took our elderley cat who was struggling to breathe . Upon arrival late at night we were greeted by a  young lady who asked our name and the collected the cat and sprinted with her upstairs . . After a short time we were spoken to by a vet called Sonia who was very sympathetic .  She discussed the various problems and advised it was life threatening. But she wanted to give her a chance . So we agreed a plan and also not to resuscitate and she was admitted .

At 1.00am we were called and advised she  was getting worse. And was given a sedative and shortly afterwards passed away.

At 430 am called Sonia who explained hin detail what had caused her passing .  She then advised me re cremation etc and left it is to decide.

We decided to pick the cat up to bury at home  upon arrival all the staff we re very sympathetic and out is at ease . They took paw
Prints and fur cuts . Without any prompting a refund was offered .

Thank you everyone for making a difficult one more acceptable .

Nigel and Diane
Even though it was a sad time having to say goodbye to gizzy our loved shitzu, all the staff were very kind and made the experience much easier, thankyou

Very poor customer service. Multiple vets seemed unqualified and lacking in experience. We was promised a fixed price which will cover what we needed and more but they now want to add extra costs on for more tests and charge us to even bring our dog home with no explanation why.
One minute our dog is okay the next she's going to be put to sleep and then again change thier mind and say she isn't going to die yet.

A fantastic experience when calling to query medications for two dogs. The call handler Dawn, was very courteous, she identified and solved our discrepancy with pet plans during the call. We did not feel rushed despite it being a busy bank holiday weekend. You really help us, thank you :)
Fantastic team , very caring
Emily was a brilliant vet; very informative, passionate, understanding and personable.
Looked after our rabbits really well.  Highly recommend!
All the staff at Birstall were brilliant with our unwell cat. It was a late evening visit and despite them being busy with emergencies we were seen and out within an hour.

Cannot comend the staff at vets4pets enough! They were so kind and caring as   if Ripple was their own baby and the care she recieved was second to none, sending us regular updates the whole time she was in hospital. Without their care she would not be at home with us today ❤️

Having got home after my own practice had closed for the day recently, I found my dwarf hamster clearly very unwell. Vets4Pets Birstall were compassionate to the situation and arranged for me to bring her in right away. The vet who saw us was so lovely, very understanding that she was a beloved pet but also very honest about her prognosis and we agreed it was kindest to let her go, I felt 100% comfortable that my girl would be cared for with the respect and dignity she deserved. They also thoughtfully sent me a condolence card which arrived in the post today.
Brilliant staff and care. My cat recently got spayed and it was an excellent experience.
Very helpful staff and the vet that we saw was very informative which helped our worries with our pet.

Our cat Phoebe recently had surgery here. I cannot thank Vets for Pets Birstall enough for their professionalism and compassion during this time. All the vets, nurses and receptionists were fantastic throughout, and i would highly recommend. Thankyou again.

Visited the vets for pets. Top service as always. It is expensive without insurance, but I definitely respect the time it takes to learn all of it. There are no hidden costs and are very upfront about all of the treatment options, even the worst case. Very knowledgeable and experienced staff.
Professional staff, and very helpful

Rushed my cat for emergency and have been seen as soon as we arrived. I was welcomed  by friendly staff and vet was taking seriously her condition. They have good equipment in place for closer check up and could target on time abdominal leak which was deadly to my cat and emergency surgery was successfully performed. After 3 weeks she is recovered well and scar is healing well. I will be forever grateful to surgeon and team taking good care of my cat and for keeping me informed. People here truly care about pets and my cat’s behaviour shows she was comfortable being there when before she had big stress going to vets. She has been diagnosed with lymphoma and unfortunately our journey will continue with Cancer Care for pets in Huddersfield. I was offered the treatment here, but must to admit price was rock high, however, referral was made same day when requested. I trust this place and would recommend to others.
Lovely people here
Great vets who can see your pet quickly, including out of hours, don't rip you off and truly love and care!

Brought in three stray kittens, told them one had a broken leg and needed help. Finally got them to look at the kitten and they said it was all fine, nothing wrong, and even suggested we put the kittens back where we found them. Took them to another vet who instantly could tell something was wrong and ordered an X-ray to discover the poor kitten has a broken pelvis. Complete disregard for this kitten, no compassion or care whatsoever.
Excellent. was really concerned about my dog contacted emergency vet. What lovely caring staff. brilliant service 🐕‍🦺 x …
Excellent. Lots of choice.
Excellent place, full of loads of products and friendly staff.
Brilliant store, friendly and knowledgeable staff, the manager, Lee, was brilliant and had time to talk.
Great Place and Nice vets and staff

Vets4pets policy on emergency treatment is disgusting. £80 to be seen if it’s an emergency, even though it’s Monday at 10, not even emergency hours.
Abbey house In Morley were amazing and not money driven. £51 to be seen OOH and focused on the need of my beloved dog.
I’d give 1 star but it’s not the staffs fault.
Disgusting policies with greedy people. No concern for the welfare!
